lead: What you can see in the sky tonight with your own eyes: which planets are up, where to look, and the Moon.
try: Press Use my location. The page lists what is up tonight and which way to look. On a phone, press Point my phone and hold it up to the sky.
points: Planets shine steadily and twinkle less than stars. Venus and Jupiter are the brightest.
The Moon rises about 50 minutes later each day.
The Moon moves through 27 nakshatras, about one a day. The page shows tonight's nakshatra and tithi, and when they change, worked out to within a few minutes.
